long_raw_utterances_gt_12s.text: The past may be sweet, but the road ahead is longer. Fine, it's time to let go and return to my original path. As they say, when the road is hard, ambition comes first. Make a name at the Great Wall, achieve great deeds. I, Bai Xiaochun, in a snap, faced the Giant Ghost in the wilderness, flying flames, all traces vanishing.

To survive and safely return to the Great Wall, I had no choice but to disguise myself as a beast that died with a grievance. On the eve of atonement, in the wilderness, amid turbulent power shifts, I frantically profited. Finally, I successfully ascended to Heavenly Dao Nascent Soul. I thought this journey was complete and I could happily return, but who knew a top-tier showdown with the world's fate as the stake was already in play. The outcome of this game—

After guarding the tomb for over ten thousand years, I have upheld the heart of the Great Dao and chosen the front hall of Xuanqing City. The Underworld Emperor's succession ceremony will be held in one month.
Truly lives up to its reputation! Are you alright, sir? ...
I was created by the Sovereign to guard the Sovereign's great veil, to oversee reincarnation, and to guard the Gate of Worlds. No unorthodox entity may pass through.

As the Tomb Keeper, there are many things I cannot interfere with. My time is nearly up and I am about to depart. The time I have left to guard these two existences is running short. Now even this world is showing signs of...
...signs of breaking. Unlike the Tomb Keeper's mission, the Underworld Emperor, Chaos, and the Underworld River eternally guard the Spirit Palace, protecting reincarnation.
Grandpa, you're the one in a rush to pick an heir for the Eternal Spirit Palace.
Sir, actually I'm not that— Sir, aren't you mistaken? The Underworld Emperor's seat would be better suited to my master. Fate… could it be that you—
to become the Underworld Emperor. I once altered the course of your life, placing you by his side.
